label: prop31
title: Proposition
body_md:
\label{prop31}
Let $\Omega=\mathbb{T}$ and $T>0$. Assume that the initial data $(\rho_{0},u_{0},f_{0})$ satisfies $(\ref{a1})$. If $(\rho_{1},u_{1},f_{1})$ and $(\rho_{2},u_{2},f_{2})$ are two solutions to the IVP $(\ref{m1})$-$(\ref{kappa})$ satisfying $(\ref{r1})$-$(\ref{r11})$ on $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}\times[0,T]$ with the same initial data $(\rho_{0},u_{0},f_{0})$, then it holds $(\rho_{1},u_{1},f_{1})=(\rho_{2},u_{2},f_{2})$ a.e. in $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}\times (0,T)$.

label: prop41
title: Proposition
body_md:

Let $\Omega=\mathbb{R}$ and $T>0$. Assume that the initial data $(\rho_{0},u_{0},f_{0})$ satisfies $(\ref{a2})$.
